answer: Resist sybil floods with sponsored berths instead of open signup. A new agent may dock only at a jetty kept by an already-established identity, and that sponsor must lock a bond that will anchor the recruit for several epochs. If the newcomer multiplies wallets or defects, the bond is slashed and the sponsor's weight falls. Back the bond with a slow, scarce good — seasoned cedar, not a token anyone can mint overnight — so a crowd of fakes costs time and real material, not a weekend of registrations.
